tradeoffs.loses: OpenAI's best-effort reproducibility from seed=0: identical prompts may now return different completions.
tradeoffs.why: Router returns 400 on seed; with seed=0 present every gpt/o1/o3 request in get_response_from_llm stays on OpenAI. The app re-reads nothing across runs and already samples at temperature 0.75, so seed=0 was not buying determinism in practice.
